statement.text:
Does the group of isometries of Q3 have a free non-abelian subgroup such
that every non-trivial element acts without nontrivial fixed points in Q3 ?
    The answer is yes if the field of rational numbers Q is replaced by the field R of
real numbers (see G. Tomkowicz, S. Wagon, The Banach–Tarski Paradox, Cambridge
Univ. Press, 2016.)                                                        J. Mycielski
